description: This file contains the implementation of the PdfFlattenVisitor class, which inherits from VisitorBase. It provides functionality to traverse and modify document elements related to PDF rendering within the MigraDoc library, including flattening document structure, processing text and formatting, and handling hyperlinks.

classes.name: PdfFlattenVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses document object elements to flatten or process them for PDF rendering purposes.

methods.name: VisitDocumentElements
methods.description: Processes a collection of document elements, splitting paragraphs on breaks, inserting and removing objects as needed.

methods.name: VisitDocumentObjectCollection
methods.description: Processes a collection of document objects, especially for handling text content and inserting line breaks or special spaces.

methods.name: VisitFormattedText
methods.description: Adjusts the font styles for formatted text based on styles and parent elements.

methods.name: VisitHyperlink
methods.description: Adjusts hyperlink appearance and font based on style and parent context.

methods.name: GetParentFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font style from the parent object (Paragraph, Hyperlink, or FormattedText).
